summary: Two disconnected review systems exist. (A) site00_client_review_* tables (P0.CLIENT.2) — the client app reads/writes these, but nothing in production creates review objects and nothing on the workspace side reads the results. (B) site00_approval_requests / site00_project_deliverables (Production OS) — has CLIENT_REVIEW / CLIENT_APPROVED statuses read by admin control and client studio, but no code transitions anything into CLIENT_REVIEW and the client app never touches it. There is no ONE shared project truth for reviews.

steps.step: 1. Production workspace has a reviewable artifact
steps.evidence: site00_project_deliverables + site00_approval_requests (supabase/migrations/20260818143000_site00_production_os.sql:200-217); founder project OS REVIEWS module renders operatingState.reviewsState which is hardcoded [] (shared/site00-projects/generalizedProjectOperatingState.ts:211; src/site00/components/projectOperatingSystem/ProjectModulePanels.tsx:262-284)
steps.gap: Workspace REVIEWS module is always empty; design-workspace authorities/families are not modeled as reviewable objects.

steps.evidence: No code path creates non-preview rows in site00_client_review_objects; only upsertPreviewReviewObject (api/_lib/site00ClientReviews/reviewRepository.ts:629-680) called from previewFixtureSeed.ts:31. decideApproval only sets APPROVED_INTERNALLY|REVISION (api/_lib/site00Production/service.ts:366-382). grep for send-to-client / SENT_TO_CLIENT / READY_TO_SEND returns nothing.
steps.gap: No send action, no endpoint, no UI button. CLIENT_REVIEW/READY_FOR_CLIENT statuses are only ever read (controlCommand.ts:280-283; clientStudio.ts:419-423), never written.

steps.evidence: GET /api/site00/client-reviews?action=queue -> loadReviewObjectsForProject filters project_slug + client_visible (reviewRepository.ts:282-293); UI AppReviewsQueuePage.tsx:15-37
steps.gap: Queue always empty for real projects (step 2). Client hook uses bare fetch() without Authorization (src/site00/hooks/useClientReviews.ts:10) while getAuthUser requires Bearer (api/_lib/auth.ts:18-20) => 401 'REVIEWS UNAVAILABLE' in production. No notification on arrival.

steps.evidence: submitClientApproval writes receipt (decision_type APPROVE), sets client_status APPROVED, inserts APPROVED event (reviewService.ts:334-404); UI ClientAppReviewDetailView.tsx:118-135,355-366
steps.gap: Works only against preview fixtures; auth header missing (AppReviewsQueuePage.tsx:39-50 bare fetch); role tamperable via body.role (client-reviews.ts:155); no approvalAllowed check server-side; does not set version is_approved or approved_at column.

steps.evidence: submitClientRevision -> receipt REVISION with summary/commentIds/annotationIds/category, client_status REVISION_IN_PROGRESS, event REVISION_REQUESTED (reviewService.ts:406-478)
steps.gap: Same auth/role issues; revision receipt status stays 'RECEIVED' forever — no workspace path acknowledges/resolves.

steps.evidence: addClientReviewComment / addClientReviewAnnotation insert into site00_client_review_comments/annotations + events (reviewService.ts:229-332)
steps.gap: No founder reply path; comment status OPEN never transitions (no writer of ACKNOWLEDGED/RESOLVED).

steps.evidence: Only reader of client decisions for founders is getClientReviewAdminFeedback (reviewService.ts:179-206) exposed as GET action=adminFeedback (client-reviews.ts:92-103); no src/ consumer calls adminFeedback (grep). site00_client_review_events is not read by any workspace/admin module. Email template 'CLIENT REVIEW SUBMITTED' exists (shared/site00-email/registry/templates.ts:1162) but is not dispatched from reviewService.
steps.gap: Workspace never learns of client action. adminFeedback also requires owner access (assertReviewProjectAccess -> canAccessProjectAsOwner), blocking admins who are not the client.

steps.evidence: reviewService only updates site00_client_review_objects.client_status (reviewRepository.ts:606-627). No update to site00_projects, site00_project_deliverables, site00_approval_requests, or refreshProjectDerivedState.
steps.gap: Project phase/progress/home 'current moment' unaffected by approval.

steps.evidence: Gate logic keys on deliverable status CLIENT_APPROVED (api/_lib/site00Production/dependencyEngine.ts:10-13; readinessEvaluator.ts:61), but no code writes CLIENT_APPROVED from a client action.
steps.gap: No bridge from client approval receipt to deliverable/authority status.

schema.missing_table: site00_project_events (read by roomService.ts:79, written by appService.ts:136) has no CREATE TABLE in supabase/migrations.

review_send.reason: No production code creates site00_client_review_objects or moves deliverables/approvals to CLIENT_REVIEW; only preview fixture seeding.

client_approval.reason: Durable approve endpoint with receipts/idempotency exists, but client hooks send no Bearer token (401 in prod), role is client-tamperable, and there are no real review objects to approve.

request_revision.reason: Revision receipt + status + event persist, same auth/role defects; nobody consumes the request.

comment_return.reason: Comments persist but no founder UI reads them (adminFeedback endpoint unused and owner-gated) and no reply path.

approval_return_loop.reason: Approval updates only client_status on the client table; no deliverable/project/gate update, no notification, no workspace read.

client_inbox.reason: Three hardcoded fixture threads for every project; fake messages; SEND has no handler; no messages table.

client_library.reason: Categories from template with 0 items; same two fake files for every category; null download URLs; viewer is placeholder text.

client_invite.reason: Only self-activation by an already-owning client writes metadata flag; no founder invite, no token acceptance, no email (invitationSent:false), event table missing from migrations.

client_project_room.reason: Real auth/ownership and project row power shell + phase list, but Home/Project content is template copy, nav diverges from canon, web room library/activity/messages are placeholders, and project-room hook omits auth header.
